title: 先進氧化微污染物處理~Advanced oxidation of micropollutants
focus: 自由基曝露、光能與副產物證據~Radical exposure, photon energy and by-product evidence
summary: 以「自由基曝露、光能與副產物證據」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow radical exposure, photon energy and by-product evidence through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 目標污染物與背景水質~Target compound and matrix
units.mechanism: 微量目標物的消失率會受背景有機物與碳酸鹽競爭影響；先分開目標濃度和總氧化需求。~Background organics and carbonate compete for reactive species; distinguish target concentration from total oxidation demand.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：load=Q C; Q=100 m3/h; C=2 microgram/L; 1 mg/m3=1 microgram/L；計算 100*2 = 200 mg/h。適用限制：單一目標物質量負荷。~Original hypothetical teaching example: load=Q C; Q=100 m3/h; C=2 microgram/L; 1 mg/m3=1 microgram/L; calculation 100*2 = 200 mg/h. Applicability: Mass load of one target compound.
units.verify: 固定目標物濃度，改變背景DOC比較反應速率。~Keep target concentration fixed and vary background DOC to compare reaction rate.
units.failure: 只依目標物質量估氧化劑可能漏掉主要清除劑。~Dosing from target mass alone misses dominant scavengers.
units.misconception: 目標物濃度低就代表氧化需求必定低。~Low target concentration necessarily means low oxidation demand.
units.practice: 在「目標污染物與背景水質」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 200 mg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依目標物質量估氧化劑可能漏掉主要清除劑。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for target compound and matrix, first reproduce 200 mg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Dosing from target mass alone misses dominant scavengers." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 擬一級降解模型~Pseudo-first-order decay
units.mechanism: 在氧化劑和水質近似固定的短時間區間，擬一級常數可概括觀測衰減；它不是分子本徵常數。~Over a short interval with nearly fixed oxidant and matrix, a pseudo-first-order constant summarizes observed decay; it is not an intrinsic molecular constant.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：C/C0=exp(-k t); k=0.15 /min; t=10 min；計算 exp(-0.15*10) = 0.22313 fraction。適用限制：不適用氧化劑耗盡或多相傳質主導區間。~Original hypothetical teaching example: C/C0=exp(-k t); k=0.15 /min; t=10 min; calculation exp(-0.15*10) = 0.22313 fraction. Applicability: Not applicable when oxidant is depleted or multiphase transfer dominates.
units.verify: 用半對數濃度圖檢查斜率是否近似固定。~Check for a near-constant slope on a semilog concentration plot.
units.failure: 彎曲衰減仍硬套單一常數會高估末段去除。~Forcing one constant onto curved decay can overpredict late removal.
units.misconception: 擬一級常數與水質無關。~The pseudo-first-order constant is independent of water quality.
units.practice: 在「擬一級降解模型」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.22313 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「彎曲衰減仍硬套單一常數會高估末段去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pseudo-first-order decay, first reproduce 0.22313 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Forcing one constant onto curved decay can overpredict late removal." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 所需反應時間~Required reaction time
units.mechanism: 目標去除倍數以自然對數進入一級時間式；十倍去除不等於十倍時間。~The natural logarithm of the removal ratio enters the first-order time expression; tenfold removal does not require tenfold time.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：t=ln(C0/C)/k; ratio=10; k=0.15 /min；計算 log(10)/0.15 = 15.3506 min。適用限制：以已驗證的假想固定k為條件。~Original hypothetical teaching example: t=ln(C0/C)/k; ratio=10; k=0.15 /min; calculation log(10)/0.15 = 15.3506 min. Applicability: Conditional on the validated hypothetical constant k.
units.verify: 比較90%與99%去除的時間並說明對數關係。~Compare times for90% and99% removal and explain the logarithmic relation.
units.failure: 把log10直接代入自然對數式會少算時間。~Substituting log10 into a natural-log expression underestimates time.
units.misconception: 90%和99%去除所需時間相同。~90% and99% removal take the same time.
units.practice: 在「所需反應時間」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 15.3506 min，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把log10直接代入自然對數式會少算時間。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for required reaction time, first reproduce 15.3506 min, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Substituting log10 into a natural-log expression underestimates time." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 自由基競爭分率~Competition for radicals
units.mechanism: 不同清除途徑以反應速率貢獻競爭；目標分率小時單純加藥可能效率低。~Scavenging pathways compete through their rate contributions; a small target fraction makes simple dose escalation inefficient.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：f_target=r_target/(r_target+r_background); values=2,18；計算 2/(2+18) = 0.1 fraction。適用限制：穩態自由基、僅兩個等效途徑。~Original hypothetical teaching example: f_target=r_target/(r_target+r_background); values=2,18; calculation 2/(2+18) = 0.1 fraction. Applicability: Steady-state radicals with two equivalent pathways.
units.verify: 把背景清除速率減半並比較目標分率。~Halve background scavenging and compare the target fraction.
units.failure: 把總自由基產生量當成全部作用於目標會誇大去除。~Assigning all generated radicals to the target exaggerates removal.
units.misconception: 所有自由基都會與目標污染物反應。~Every radical reacts with the target contaminant.
units.practice: 在「自由基競爭分率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總自由基產生量當成全部作用於目標會誇大去除。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for competition for radicals, first reproduce 0.1 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Assigning all generated radicals to the target exaggerates removal." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 紫外光透射與光程~UV transmission and path length
units.mechanism: 吸收使光強沿光程下降；同樣入口功率不代表每一流線得到相同光曝露。~Absorption reduces intensity along the optical path; equal input power does not give all flow paths equal exposure.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：T=10^(-a L); a=0.15 /cm; L=2 cm；計算 10**(-0.15*2) = 0.501187 fraction。適用限制：單波長均勻介質的吸收模型。~Original hypothetical teaching example: T=10^(-a L); a=0.15 /cm; L=2 cm; calculation 10**(-0.15*2) = 0.501187 fraction. Applicability: Single-wavelength absorption in a homogeneous medium.
units.verify: 改變光程，量測入口與出口光強。~Vary path length and measure entrance and exit intensity.
units.failure: 以入口光強乘停留時間會忽略陰影與吸收。~Multiplying inlet intensity by residence time ignores shadowing and absorption.
units.misconception: 入口光強就是反應器內每一點的光強。~Inlet intensity equals intensity everywhere in the reactor.
units.practice: 在「紫外光透射與光程」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.501187 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以入口光強乘停留時間會忽略陰影與吸收。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for uv transmission and path length, first reproduce 0.501187 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Multiplying inlet intensity by residence time ignores shadowing and absorption." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 有效容積與停留時間~Active volume and residence time
units.mechanism: 死區與旁通會讓名目容積高估有效接觸；示蹤測試提供流動分布而非只一個平均。~Dead zones and bypass make nominal volume overstate contact; tracer testing reveals a distribution rather than just a mean.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：t=Vactive/Q; Vactive=12 m3; Q=4 m3/min；計算 12/4 = 3 min。適用限制：完全混合與栓流的降解式不同。~Original hypothetical teaching example: t=Vactive/Q; Vactive=12 m3; Q=4 m3/min; calculation 12/4 = 3 min. Applicability: Decay differs between mixed and plug-flow reactors.
units.verify: 以脈衝示蹤比較早到峰與名目V/Q。~Compare an early tracer peak with nominal V/Q.
units.failure: 平均時間合理仍可能存在未充分處理的短路流。~A plausible mean can coexist with under-treated bypass flow.
units.misconception: 平均停留時間達標就能排除所有短路流。~An acceptable mean residence time excludes every short circuit.
units.practice: 在「有效容積與停留時間」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 min，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「平均時間合理仍可能存在未充分處理的短路流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for active volume and residence time, first reproduce 3 min, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A plausible mean can coexist with under-treated bypass flow." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 單位對數去除電耗~Electrical energy per order
units.mechanism: EEO把光源耗能除以處理水量與對數去除，用於固定邊界下比較；不能忽略泵與藥劑。~EEO normalizes light-source energy by volume and logarithmic removal for a fixed boundary; it does not erase pumping or reagent costs.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：EEO=P t/[V log10(C0/C)]; P=2 kW;t=0.5 h;V=1 m3;ratio=10；計算 2*0.5/(1*log10(10)) = 1 kWh/m3/order。適用限制：批次近似，僅所列電力邊界。~Original hypothetical teaching example: EEO=P t/[V log10(C0/C)]; P=2 kW;t=0.5 h;V=1 m3;ratio=10; calculation 2*0.5/(1*log10(10)) = 1 kWh/m3/order. Applicability: Batch approximation with only the stated electricity boundary.
units.verify: 比較相同去除倍數下不同處理容積的EEO。~Compare EEO at equal removal ratio for different treated volumes.
units.failure: 把照明效率與全系統效率混同會低報耗能。~Equating lamp efficiency with system efficiency understates energy.
units.misconception: 去除百分比一樣就必定有相同EEO。~Equal percentage removal guarantees equal EEO.
units.practice: 在「單位對數去除電耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 kWh/m3/order，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把照明效率與全系統效率混同會低報耗能。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for electrical energy per order, first reproduce 1 kWh/m3/order, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Equating lamp efficiency with system efficiency understates energy." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 殘餘氧化劑與淬熄~Residual oxidant and quenching
units.mechanism: 採樣後殘餘氧化劑仍可能反應，造成樣品中濃度低於採樣時；淬熄需有空白與回收試驗。~Residual oxidant may react after sampling and lower measured concentration; quenching needs blanks and recovery tests.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：residual mass=C V; C=0.4 mg/L; V=500 L；計算 0.4*500 = 200 mg。適用限制：只算殘餘質量，不推定淬熄化學計量。~Original hypothetical teaching example: residual mass=C V; C=0.4 mg/L; V=500 L; calculation 0.4*500 = 200 mg. Applicability: Residual mass only; no assumed quench stoichiometry.
units.verify: 比較立即淬熄、延遲淬熄與空白樣品。~Compare immediate quench, delayed quench and blanks.
units.failure: 未淬熄樣品會把瓶內持續反應誤當反應器效果。~An unquenched sample misattributes bottle reaction to reactor performance.
units.misconception: 採樣離開反應器後化學反應必定立刻停止。~Chemical reactions always stop immediately after sampling.
units.practice: 在「殘餘氧化劑與淬熄」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 200 mg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未淬熄樣品會把瓶內持續反應誤當反應器效果。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for residual oxidant and quenching, first reproduce 200 mg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An unquenched sample misattributes bottle reaction to reactor performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 中間產物與碳收支~Intermediates and carbon balance
units.mechanism: 母體消失不等於礦化；追蹤中間產物、總有機碳和效應指標才能評估轉化。~Parent disappearance does not equal mineralization; track intermediates, TOC and effect measures to assess transformation.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：TOC removal=(C0-C)/C0; C0=5,C=4 mgC/L；計算 (5-4)/5 = 0.2 fraction。適用限制：TOC包含所有背景有機碳。~Original hypothetical teaching example: TOC removal=(C0-C)/C0; C0=5,C=4 mgC/L; calculation (5-4)/5 = 0.2 fraction. Applicability: TOC includes background organic carbon.
units.verify: 把母體去除率與TOC去除率畫在同一圖上。~Plot parent and TOC removal on the same chart.
units.failure: 以99%母體去除宣稱99%礦化是不同指標混用。~Claiming99% mineralization from99% parent removal conflates metrics.
units.misconception: 母體不見就代表全部轉成二氧化碳。~Disappearance of the parent means complete conversion to carbon dioxide.
units.practice: 在「中間產物與碳收支」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.2 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以99%母體去除宣稱99%礦化是不同指標混用。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for intermediates and carbon balance, first reproduce 0.2 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Claiming99% mineralization from99% parent removal conflates metrics." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 量測不確定度與放大~Uncertainty and scale-up
units.mechanism: 小試的光分布、混合與水質不能直接等比例放大；先量化資料誤差再建立相似條件。~Bench optical distribution, mixing and matrix do not scale proportionally; quantify measurement error and establish similarity first.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：combined relative u=sqrt(u1^2+u2^2); u1=0.04;u2=0.03；計算 sqrt(0.04**2+0.03**2) = 0.05 fraction。適用限制：兩個獨立小誤差的均方根近似。~Original hypothetical teaching example: combined relative u=sqrt(u1^2+u2^2); u1=0.04;u2=0.03; calculation sqrt(0.04**2+0.03**2) = 0.05 fraction. Applicability: Root-sum-square approximation for two independent small errors.
units.verify: 比較不同光程試驗，記錄量測誤差和流動條件。~Compare tests at different path lengths with measurement error and flow conditions recorded.
units.failure: 只依容積比放大燈數會漏掉光程改變。~Scaling lamp count by volume alone misses changed optical paths.
units.misconception: 小試容積乘十即可保證全尺度相同去除。~Tenfold bench volume guarantees identical full-scale removal.
units.practice: 在「量測不確定度與放大」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依容積比放大燈數會漏掉光程改變。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for uncertainty and scale-up, first reproduce 0.05 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Scaling lamp count by volume alone misses changed optical paths." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

place.coordinateScope: 近似機構所在區域位置；依公開地址作教材地圖代表點，非建物入口、實廠、實測或導航位置。

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
